- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Precision Medicine: A new medical approach that aims to understand the genetic makeup of each individual to customize treatments to their individual needs.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Gene Editing and Gene Therapy: Technologies that enable scientists to modify a patient's genes, potentially curing genetic diseases.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Diagnosis: AI algorithms analyze medical images (X-rays, CT scans, MRIs) to detect early signs of diseases like cancer and Alzheimer's.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Predictive Analytics: Algorithms analyze patient data to predict disease progression and treatment outcomes.
